1100007.DisplayDes: Fross can't stand anything that gives off heat! A fire?! Fire! Another fire? Argh!

1100008.DisplayDes: From what I've observed, ice elementals cannot stand fire. They just need to get a whiff of flame and they'll throw all the ice and snow they have at it. Fortunately, they don't actively go out of their way to harass passersby, but I'd imagine anyone cooking on an open flame out here would be in a lot of danger. You'll see a telltale frosting wherever the ice elementals have been. They will pretty much shrug off any ordinary damage, so it looks like you'll have to try drive them into the binding seal before you can do anything else.

1180010.DisplayDes: I'm not sure why, but there seems to be something strange about the inhabitants of the village to the south.

1180012.DisplayDes: How exactly do we define "evil"? Just because some folk don't share our beliefs, we call them "heretics". How can a person that is deaf to other's opinions and blind to other's cultures be called righteous and divine? It's not these creatures that are terrifying, it's the people that think in this way. I'm writing this as the real demons approach our location. We have doomed this town and ourselves.

40060042.DisplayDes: Someone has carved the following words on the table: "To those who come after: no treasure in the Polar Peaks is worth risking life and limb! Abandon your foolish crusade! Do not be swayed by promises of wealth and riches! Return from whence you came!"

40060144.DisplayDes:
Someone has carved the following words on the table: "To those who come after: I once partook in a very dangerous trade, yet which provided me great convenience.
I thought once I could ascend to the very heavens and make a name for myself across all Hathor by the strength of my arm. 
Yet I was filled with bitter regret from the day I realized my struggles were inspired by nothing more than selfish desire. I've sought remedy for my faults, but you still have a chance to turn back from the Way of Foolishness!"

40060147.DisplayDes: A terrifying Hypogean with a gaping, blood-soaked chasm of a mouth.

40060149.DisplayDes:
Someone has carved the following words on the table: "To those who come after: if you've made it this far, I'm sad to say that means my earlier warnings were rather fruitless.
It should be no surprise for my opponent is a powerful Hypogean. Yet I remain sworn to this difficult quest, and remedying the evil consequences of my actions... I have but one last chance.
I'm not afraid of being buried here. I only hope my efforts may be helpful to those who come after."

[Composers Room]: Cultivate your skills under serious pressure. Some of the most exquisite sheet music is often born in the most challenging and perilous circumstances.

1. Pull the lever, and inspiration will emerge from the void.
2. Follow the path laid by inspiration to enter deeper into the sanctuary of art.
3. But remember, seeking inspiration by pulling the lever comes at a price.

6040075.DisplayDes: Another day of helping students make music, and I'm always thrilled to guide everyone in the creative process. I'd rather encourage students to express their creativity freely than make them stick to rigid sheet music. The students seem to have a good time with this approach. But those old traditionalists don't seem to be big fans of me. Well, art is meant to be liberating, after all.

6040076.DisplayDes: When I'm in need of inspiration, I often come here to gaze out at the valley. It's as if the notes in my mind dance through the winding hills. Lately, though, I've been feeling more and more confused. Why do those people exclude me and even insult my music? My teaching method is clearly more effective and inspiring for my students.

6040077.DisplayDes: I haven't been able to sleep for a whole week now. The once beautiful dancing notes seem to have changed, becoming twisted and restless. Every now and then, I sense a faint whisper in my mind, talking about some sort of pact and my soul... I'd give anything for a good night's rest.

6040078.DisplayDes: This is outrageous! I would never commit these fabricated, repulsive acts! Why? Why does no one believe me? They smashed my instruments, burned my sheet music, even clamored to send me to prison!
